title: You can now easily generate tilesets, inpaint directly in the browser, and build full maps with ease 🔥
author: Kaninen_Ka9en

comments.author: Kaninen_Ka9en
comments.body: You can check it out at [www.pixellab.ai](http://www.pixellab.ai) :) We also have tools for sprite generation and character + rotation + animations generation

comments.author: Aadi_880
comments.body: This this support platformer style tilesets? Or must it only be top-down?

replies.author: Kaninen_Ka9en
replies.body: This map creator doesnt support sidescroller yet but you can generate sidescroller/platform tilesets. We will be adding sidescroller support in the near future :)

comments.author: DisasterNarrow4949
comments.body:
Incredible Tool! 

The maps are pretty big, what are the options for exporting?

replies.author: Kaninen_Ka9en
replies.body: Currently its images and json files. You can access the tilesets from the MCP if you want to vibe code :)

replies.author: DisasterNarrow4949
replies.body: Thanks for the answer. Cool! Does the Godot API already have integration with the esported content? It would be very cool if we could import everything from the jsons directly into a scene! Although If this function is not implementei, It is ok as It should be pretty straightfoward to code one Godot myself for any project I may create using this map buider.

replies.author: HugoDzz
replies.body: Pixellab can export tilesets for [Sprite Fusion](https://www.spritefusion.com/), which supports one-click exports to Godot 3 and 4 :)

replies.author: Kaninen_Ka9en
replies.body: in the top right there is an export button, is it not working for you?
